🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 21, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a trine to Moon, in detriment in Capricorn. Two earth placements agreeing on the terms: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. Moon in Capricorn squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. The square of two weeks ago is off it now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Capricorn, Moon agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Earth keeps what it has, cheaply. Two weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Libra. Sun squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Air adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. Since Mercury crossed out of Leo, the question has changed.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you, exiled in Capricorn. Sun in Virgo leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Water that starts things, started cheaply. Venus let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Virgo untitled. Mercury sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Fixed fire keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. The hold Mercury had three weeks ago is not there any more.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. Moon trines you from Capricorn, and what you hold finds words unforced. Mutable earth keeps two accounts, and both balance. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. From Capricorn, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Cardinal air starts and is invoiced for it. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. From Capricorn, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Water keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Virgo, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Mutable fire keeps two accounts open and pays both. The trine to Moon that held three weeks ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Earth starts and settles in the same breath. Two weeks ago Saturn was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Mercury in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon sextiles you from Capricorn: an opening to be reached for. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.
